text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Opera O! I thought of a cool one-liner!
Couldja
give it a listen for me?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I spent all night thinking it up, so I'm
sure it's a
masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaa-ha-ha-ha-ha! All right, show me
the depth
of your abyss!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I am the Ultimate Supernova of the
Racecourse!
Pull my trigger and watch
me fly... Bam!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I could feel the radical nature of your
nightmare.
The rich vibrations of your
supernova echoed
endlessly into the
night!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ohhh... How'd you make it even cooler?!
